candidate_rule: two non-promoted candidates per record: verified official fact or deterministic rounded-snapshot metric, plus explicit scope guard

scope_guards.july_snapshot: BDUK July 2026 values are rounded management-information data limited to initial contract scope, with variable ingestion lag; they do not establish exact-address completion, current availability, orderability or contractual milestone compliance.
scope_guards.supplier_metric: Supplier-label means, shares, gaps and ratios are deterministic calculations over displayed rounded rows sharing the same supplier label. They are not official supplier performance statistics, corporate assessments or parcel-level evidence.
scope_guards.standardized_metric: Population z-scores are descriptive standardisations over the 37 displayed July rows only. They depend on rounded values and do not measure quality, delay, need, contractual compliance or exact-address availability.
scope_guards.payment_scope: Payment-support options are general suggestions; providers are not required to offer every option and actual arrangements depend on account and case facts.
scope_guards.billing_scope: Billing complaint guidance describes standard escalation routes; it does not determine the correctness of a charge or the outcome of an individual complaint.
scope_guards.premium_scope: Premium-rate guidance describes identification, stopping and complaint processes; it does not prove that a specific charge was unauthorised or guarantee a refund.
scope_guards.abuse_scope: Safety guidance is general and case-sensitive; it does not determine criminal liability, provider obligations in an individual case or safe action for every person.
